purpose: Project-owned dry-run container/headless metadata profile for Lisan Studio. It advertises safe inspection checks only; real Qt/MSYS2/WiX builds remain Windows/VM-owned until a deliberate container image is selected.

execution.containerImageTodo: Choose or build a project-owned image with the exact Qt/MSYS2/WiX-equivalent toolchain before enabling live container execution.

commands.name: metadata-files-present
commands.run: test -f .codex/homelab-runner.json && test -f CMakeLists.txt && test -d scripts && test -d tests && test -d qa

notes: No secrets, credentials, tokens, .env values, private keys, certificates, or production config are declared here.
The profile intentionally avoids dependency installation and live build/test execution.
Use LisanStudio-QA for Windows GUI, MSI, installed-app, registry-touching, screenshot, and release-evidence validation.
